channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Area Calendar, Dec. 6-7, 2024
item.description: The Barton College men's basketball team hosts Elizabeth City State at Wilson Gymnasiu on Saturday, Dec. 6.

item.title: Wilson teams to bookend NCHSAA football championship matchups
item.description: For the first time, two Wilson teams—Wilson Prep and Hunt—will open and close the NCHSAA football championships, highlighting a historic week of title matchups across new and familiar venues.

item.title: AREA ROUNDUP: CCS boys roll past Bethel Christian
item.description: Community Christian boys and girls basketball teams dominated Bethel Christian, with standout performances pushing both squads to strong season records, while North Johnston girls stayed unbeaten with a win over Beddingfield.

item.title: Second-quarter surge dooms Wilson Christian in 74-47 loss to Faith Christian
item.description: A dominant second quarter by Faith Christian powered a 74-47 win over Wilson Christian in the Chargers Christmas Classic semifinals, sending Faith to the title game and Wilson Christian to the consolation round.

item.title: WCA girls surge into Chargers Christmas Classic final with dominant win over Faith Christian
item.description: Wilson Christian’s girls basketball team advanced to the Chargers Christmas Classic final with a 48-20 win over Faith Christian, led by Katie McBryde’s double-double and strong team defense.

item.title: Hunter’s Dance marks 16 years of ‘The Grinch’
item.description: Hunter’s Dance celebrates 16 years of its beloved “The Grinch” production, bringing humor, heart and new surprises to the stage for families across North Carolina Dec. 12-15 at the Edna Boykin Cultural Center.

item.title: Parade spreads Christmas cheer in downtown Wilson
item.description: Thousands braved chilly weather to enjoy Wilson’s 2025 Christmas Parade, featuring festive floats, school bands and community spirit.

item.title: Ride On Cannon Foundation makes Christmas brighter for local kids
item.description: The Ride On Cannon Foundation, created in memory of Cannon Hinnant, is bringing holiday cheer to hundreds of local children through wish trees, donations and community events in Wilson and beyond.

item.title: Wilson County deed transfers recorded week of Nov. 24-28
item.description: Wilson County recorded multiple property transfers the week of Nov. 24-28, including residential and commercial sales ranging from $2,500 to $1.7 million.

item.title: Community invited to WCC holiday concert
item.description: Wilson Community College hosts a free holiday concert on Monday featuring its chorus and new Community Orchestra, with donations supporting music scholarships for aspiring students.
